## Public-safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, credentials, or `.env` values.
- [ ] No personal data, customer data, or private account details.
- [ ] No production-only URLs, IDs, or configuration.
- [ ] Placeholders use angle brackets where specific values are needed.
- [ ] Any screenshots, logs, or examples are sanitized.

## Adoption checklist

- [ ] A first-time user can tell what to copy or open.
- [ ] README, file tree, or examples were updated if paths changed.
- [ ] The change works for a ZIP download or copied starter vault when relevant.
- [ ] Human approval is still required before merge, publication, deploy, billing, forms, or irreversible operations.
